subject: gk
question:
Identify the FALSE statement(s).

A. In the context of Green Revolution HYV stands for Hybrid Yielding Variety.

B. Fallowing is a practice of leaving land uncultivated for some time for it to regain its fertility.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **High Yielding Variety (HYV)** is the correct term used in the context of the Green Revolution, not Hybrid Yielding Variety.

• HYVs are crops that have been genetically enhanced to increase the amount of produce per acre.

• Fallowing is indeed a practice of leaving the land uncultivated for a period to regain its fertility.

• Fallowing helps in the natural restoration of soil nutrients without the need for chemical fertilizers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Green Revolution**

• The Green Revolution refers to a period when agriculture in many developing countries was transformed due to technological innovations.

• **Fallowing**

• Fallowing is an agricultural practice where the land is left uncultivated for a certain period to allow it to regain its natural fertility.

• This practice helps in the natural restoration of soil nutrients, improving soil health and structure.

• Fallowing can also help in controlling weeds, pests, and diseases.

• It is an important part of sustainable agriculture and helps in maintaining the ecological balance.

• **High Yielding Varieties (HYVs)**

• HYVs are crops that have been scientifically developed to produce more yield per hectare compared to traditional varieties.

• These varieties are often more resistant to diseases and pests and can thrive under optimal conditions with proper irrigation and fertilizer use.

• The introduction of HYVs was a key component of the Green Revolution, leading to increased agricultural productivity.

• Common examples of HYVs include certain strains of wheat, rice, and maize.
